messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "Incorrect Purchase Order on Invoices",
 "problem_statement": "Customers face reconciliation and payment delays because invoices contain wrong purchase order numbers. This mismatch disrupts finance workflows and blocks timely payments.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "I’m trying to get our purchase order number updated on your latest invoice — it’s currently wrong and needs to reflect our internal tracking correctly.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-30T15:57:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "we need to update the purchase order reference on our most recent invoice — it’s causing reconciliation issues with our finance team.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-11T12:00:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "I’m writing to request an update to the purchase order number on your invoice — this is causing reconciliation issues, and I need the invoice contact change reflected accurately in our records.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-06T09:09:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "We need to adjust the purchase order reference on the invoice you sent — it’s causing reconciliation problems with our finance team, and we’re hoping you can help with the purchase order correction.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-11T12:00:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "The PO we referenced doesn’t match what’s on your billing, and it’s blocking our payment cycle.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-30T15:59:00Z"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The claim is that invoices contain incorrect purchase order numbers, disrupting reconciliation and payments. All five quotes consistently describe the same product problem: wrong PO numbers appearing on Keelwater-generated invoices, causing reconciliation issues and blocked payment cycles (e.g., 'The PO we referenced doesn't match what's on your billing, and it's blocking our payment cycle'). This is not answered by a help article, is not praise, and its cause lies in the product's invoice/billing data rather than pricing, contracts, or the customer's own IT. A squad could act on how PO numbers are captured and reflected on invoices.","verdict": "pass"}
